reason: 55 CZK for one can is a lot when I make under 19 thousand a month, and before a ride I just have a coffee at home for a few crowns and water in my bottle. I don't drink energy drinks, so I'm not really looking to replace anything.
objection: I'd pay 55 CZK for something that might taste like bitter grass tea, when coffee already does the job for almost nothing.
would_change_my_mind: Trying it free or as a cheap single can in a café after a hike and finding it actually tastes good and refreshing, at a price closer to 35 CZK.
